title: Finish Ready first journey through parent home
prompt: Act as implementation worker, not planner. Work only on the currently configured isolated Ready & Set branch. Do not deploy, release, switch branches, commit, push, read secrets, or enable paid AI/image generation. Fix and complete the actual zero-cost first-journey flow as one coherent user journey, not as isolated micro-fixes. Required path: PHOTO with an already-selected source photo -> tapping '다음 · 캐릭터 기분 선택' reliably renders CHARACTER -> mood cards visibly mount -> user can choose exactly 3 mood directions -> the character step remains cost-safe (paid generation stays locked) and clearly offers the existing no-cost defer/continue path -> EXPLORER selection -> THEME/world selection -> completion -> guardian setup lands in the parent home where timetable and homework are first-class actions. Preserve sourcePhoto and identity facts throughout. Do not fake characterVisualId or mark generated output as confirmed. Fix the underlying owner boundaries/event/render lifecycle so iOS/in-app-browser focus/pageshow recovery cannot swallow the PHOTO transition or starve the candidate mount. Remove any mutation/render loop that can replace the active tap target or crash Chromium. Add/repair one bounded end-to-end browser regression that exercises the full zero-cost path through parent home at a mobile viewport, without calling /api/character-candidates or any paid endpoint. It must fail if CHARACTER/mood UI does not appear, if the defer route cannot reach EXPLORER/THEME, or if parent home timetable/homework actions are missing. Keep changes minimal and production-safe. Run relevant existing contracts plus the new browser regression. Return only after the branch code itself is changed and tests pass locally, or stop with a precise blocker if the repo state makes this impossible.
